title: What is RPA (robotic process automation)? | 50agents
description: RPA is software that replays a person's recorded clicks in an app's screens. How it differs from a browser agent, with a real example from 50agents.
definition: RPA, robotic process automation, is software that replays the clicks and keystrokes a person recorded in an application's screens.
It follows that path exactly, so it breaks when a screen changes.

example.ask: Set up a browser agent that checks my competitors' pricing pages every day at 9:00 and tells me when a price changes
example.why: Recorded clicks break on a redesign; the browser agent looks for the prices.
